name: Street furniture (fountain, market stall, cart, amphorae, honorific statue)
license: original procedural geometry (TIMELINES Studio); materials use CC0 Poly Haven textures, see data/textures/LICENSES.json
source: procedural bpy generator tl_buildings.py / tl_nature.py (via build_assets.py)
historical_accuracy_notes: Pompeii-type street fountain (four stone slabs and a spout pillar), timber trestle stall with a cloth awning, two-wheeled cart with disc wheels, Dressel-like transport amphorae, draped honorific statue on an inscribed plinth (abstracted figure, no portrait). All dimensions are estimates; the statue is deliberately generic.
references: Pompeii: street fountains and stepping stones (e.g. Via dell'Abbondanza)
Dressel, H. (1899), amphora typology table, CIL XV
